TERMINOLOGY_GUARD.why: a pair claim asserts only co-occurrence at two ordered positions. True state-change semantics belong ONLY to tokens whose own definition is a transition (e.g. sig_tz_flip).
the_claim_does_NOT_assert: only A and B were active
TERMINOLOGY_GUARD.the_claim_asserts_exactly: TOKEN_A is TRUE at M_i AND TOKEN_B is TRUE at M_{i+1}

SINGLE_POSITION_CLAIMS.may_be: support DIAGNOSTIC only, never a hypothesis claim
rationale: the programme's state-transition question is built on adjacent pairs from the outset
the historical T1 grammar was M1->M2, M2->M3, M3->M4
excluding it a priori prevents deciding AFTER seeing support that some single-position effect is also wanted

AVAILABILITY_SEMANTICS.PAIR_EVALUABLE: A.source AVAILABLE_VALID at left position AND B.source AVAILABLE_VALID at right position
AVAILABILITY_SEMANTICS.POSITIVE_PAIR: pair evaluable AND both tokens TRUE
AVAILABILITY_SEMANTICS.NEGATIVE_PAIR: pair evaluable AND at least one token FALSE
AVAILABILITY_SEMANTICS.INVARIANT: UNAVAILABLE != FALSE — an unavailable side NEVER counts as a non-fire

FORBIDDEN_CLAIM_FORMS: exact-bundle semantics (e.g. A@M1 AND B@M1 AND nothing else)

PRE_SUPPORT_CLAIM_UNIVERSE.derivation: 123 tokens x 123 tokens x 3 position pairs
PRE_SUPPORT_CLAIM_UNIVERSE.verified: enumerated and de-duplicated at seal time; 45,387 unique claim ids
PRE_SUPPORT_CLAIM_UNIVERSE.EXPLICITLY_NOT_K: this is the PRE-SUPPORT universe. k is computed only AFTER the support floor is frozen and applied.

SUPPORT_METRICS_PRESPECIFIED.scope: named now, BEFORE any distribution is observed

top-10% securities share of positive occurrences

SUPPORT_METRICS_PRESPECIFIED.authority: DEV support is the registry eligibility authority; TRUE FORWARD is confirmation authority later

TOKEN_CLOSURE_GUARD.consequence: the l_sig producer fallback labels, already semantically excluded from the dictionary, cannot re-enter the claim grammar by any path
